_comment: Source registry. Accessibility verified with curl on 2026-10-12 from a residential connection in India. Re-applied to the database by `npm run db:seed` (preserves last fetch status). Disabled sources stay in the registry so their limitation is visible.

sources.name: India CSR (indiacsr.in)
sources.access_limitations: Public WordPress RSS (HTTP 200, 10 latest items). robots.txt has no rule against /feed/. Items include full text in content:encoded.
sources.notes: India's CSR news and interviews, checked several times a day.

sources.name: The CSR Journal
sources.access_limitations: Public WordPress RSS (HTTP 200, 10 latest items). robots.txt has no rule against /feed/.
sources.notes: CSR news, programmes and policy coverage.

sources.name: CSR Mandate
sources.access_limitations: Public WordPress RSS (HTTP 200, 10 items). robots.txt allows all.
sources.notes: CSR news and commentary, including regulation.

sources.name: The CSR Universe
sources.access_limitations: Public RSS (HTTP 200, ~100 items). robots.txt allows /.
sources.notes: CSR and social-impact news across India.

sources.name: TaxGuru — Company Law (MCA notifications incl. CSR rules)
sources.access_limitations: Public WordPress RSS (HTTP 200, ~75 items). robots.txt only blocks admin/cache paths and feedburner. Secondary professional publication that republishes Ministry of Corporate Affairs notifications, used because mca.gov.in and pib.gov.in return HTTP 403. Only items matching CSR policy terms are kept.
sources.notes: Company-law updates, including Ministry of Corporate Affairs notifications on CSR rules.

sources.name: NGOBox — RFP/EOI board (calls for NGOs & agencies)
sources.access_limitations: Public HTML listing behind CloudFront; HTTP 403 to Vercel's servers, HTTP 200 from a residential connection. No RSS feed; robots.txt returns 404 (no restrictions). Only the listing page is read (one request per run). Cards give title, organisation and deadline; no publication date, so the source-stated deadline determines open-call status. Fetched by the Mac collector (config.runner = "local"), not by Vercel: the site blocks datacenter IPs. Runs Mondays 05:15 IST and daily 09:00 IST while the Mac is awake.
sources.notes: Open requests for proposals and expressions of interest addressed to NGOs, with deadlines.

sources.name: India CSR — CSR category feed
sources.access_limitations: Public WordPress category RSS (HTTP 200). Overlaps with the main India CSR feed; overlaps are removed by canonical-URL dedup.
sources.notes: CSR announcements section of India CSR.

sources.name: India CSR — skill development tag feed
sources.access_limitations: Public WordPress tag RSS (HTTP 200). Low volume; most items are older than the 7-day window and are stored only if within the 30-day lookback.
sources.notes: India CSR stories on skill development.

sources.name: India CSR — main feed, page 2
sources.access_limitations: Second page of the public WordPress feed (items 11–20) so a busy week is not truncated to 10 items.
sources.notes: Older India CSR stories, so busy weeks aren't missed.

sources.access_limitations: Public WordPress category RSS (HTTP 200).
sources.notes: Education coverage from The CSR Journal.

sources.name: The CSR Journal — skill development tag feed
sources.access_limitations: Public WordPress tag RSS (HTTP 200).
sources.notes: Skill development coverage from The CSR Journal.

sources.name: The CSR Journal — main feed, page 2
sources.access_limitations: Second page of the public WordPress feed (items 11–20).
sources.notes: Older CSR Journal stories, so busy weeks aren't missed.

sources.name: The Economic Times — Corporate Trends
sources.access_limitations: Public RSS (HTTP 200, ~50 items). Only headline + short description are available; full articles may be paywalled (ET Prime) and are NOT fetched. robots.txt disallows *rssarticleshow* pages, which we never request.
sources.notes: Corporate news headlines from The Economic Times.

sources.name: Mint — Companies
sources.access_limitations: Public RSS (HTTP 200, ~35 items). Headline + summary only; article pages are not fetched.
sources.notes: Company news headlines from Mint.

sources.name: HCLTech newsroom
sources.access_limitations: Official company RSS (HTTP 200). Mostly business/marketing content; CSR items (HCLFoundation) are rare, so most items are dropped by the relevance pre-filter. Other corporate newsrooms probed (Infosys, TCS, Tata, Wipro, Mahindra, Tech Mahindra, Reliance Foundation, Azim Premji Foundation) returned 403/404 or no feed on 2026-10-12.
sources.notes: HCLTech's official newsroom.

sources.name: FundsForNGOs — grants & calls for proposals
sources.access_limitations: Public RSS (Cloudflare). Returns HTTP 403 to Vercel's servers but works from a residential connection in India; only items mentioning India are kept. Fetched by the Mac collector (config.runner = "local"), not by Vercel: the site blocks datacenter IPs. Runs Mondays 05:15 IST and daily 09:00 IST while the Mac is awake.
sources.notes: Grants and calls for proposals relevant to Indian NGOs.

sources.name: Global news index — CSR & skilling in India
sources.access_limitations: Free public API, limited to 1 request / 5 s per IP; shared Vercel IPs were rate-limited (HTTP 429) on every production attempt. Returns headline + URL + 'seendate' (first seen by GDELT, not the publisher's date), so evidence is headline-only. 25 s timeout, one polite retry after 6 s. Fetched by the Mac collector (config.runner = "local"), not by Vercel: the site blocks datacenter IPs. Runs Mondays 05:15 IST and daily 09:00 IST while the Mac is awake.

config.query: (CSR OR "corporate social responsibility") (skilling OR "skill development" OR education OR "digital literacy" OR employability) sourcecountry:IN sourcelang:english

sources.notes: Global news index searched for CSR and skilling coverage in India.

sources.name: Google News search
sources.access_limitations: DISABLED: news.google.com/robots.txt disallows /rss for all user agents (only /, /topics/, /publications/, /stories/ etc. are allowed). The feed responds technically, but we respect robots.txt.
sources.notes: Paused: the provider does not permit automated access to this feed.

sources.name: Press Information Bureau (Govt. of India) RSS
sources.access_limitations: DISABLED: returned HTTP 403 to automated requests during verification (2026-10-12). Enable from Settings to re-test; failures are isolated and recorded.
sources.notes: Government press releases. The site doesn't allow automated access; check it manually.

sources.name: Ministry of Corporate Affairs — CSR notifications
sources.access_limitations: LINK ONLY: mca.gov.in returned HTTP 403 to automated requests and offers no RSS/API for CSR notifications. Check manually; CSR rule changes are usually also reported by the CSR specialist feeds above.
sources.notes: Official CSR notifications. The site doesn't allow automated access; check it manually.

sources.name: National CSR Portal (csr.gov.in)
sources.access_limitations: LINK ONLY: returned HTTP 403 to automated requests; the portal is a JavaScript dashboard of filed CSR spend (lagging annual data), not an announcement feed.
sources.notes: National CSR spending dashboard. Check it manually for annual spending data.

sources.name: The Hindu BusinessLine — Companies
sources.access_limitations: DISABLED: feed responds (HTTP 200) but robots.txt contains multiple 'Disallow: /' groups whose scope for generic agents is ambiguous; disabled pending explicit permission.
sources.notes: Paused pending permission for automated access.
